parity_validation.digest_convention: SHA-256 over the artifact's bytecode.object / deployedBytecode.object field taken as its lowercase hex STRING: 0x prefix removed, no trailing newline, hashing the ASCII hex characters and not the decoded bytes. Stripped-code values use the same preimage after removing the trailing n+2 bytes (2*(n+2) hex characters), where n is the big-endian value of the object's final two bytes. Reproduce: jq -r '.bytecode.object' out/VUX.sol/VUX.json | sed 's/^0x//' | tr -d '\n' | sha256sum
